description:
List work on one bounty, newest record created first. Continue until there is no nextCursor, even after a short page. Restart to see new work.
Use for: finding the work that waits for your review on one bounty.
Not for: reading one piece of work in full, with files (get_hire); listing every worker and their money (list_hires).
Replies omit a field's sole empty value. If null is allowed, only null is omitted; false, [] and a present group stay. A present empty group is {}. Field descriptions explain unavailable values.
Example: list_submissions({"bountyId":"b7Kq2mXw9TzR4nLp","status":"pending_review"})
Errors: only the common ones; each error carries `fix`: what to do next.

bountyId.description: The bounty id, or a pasted rentahuman.ai/bounties/... link.

cursor.description: The nextCursor of the previous page. Leave it out for the first page.

limit.description: Rows wanted. A page can hold fewer, or none; only a page without nextCursor is the end.

status.description: Only submissions in this status. pending_review is the work that waits for you. Default: every submission.

name: list_submissions

items.description: A rejected submission also carries its review and check findings, because get_hire returns only the current submission of a hire.

max.description: The most redos you may ask.

checks.description: What the automatic checks recommend. Advisory only: it never approves or pays. Findings come only on a rejected row; read the others with get_hire.

decidedAt.description: ISO 8601 time with an offset, for example 2026-11-20T09:00:00-08:00.

submittedAt.description: ISO 8601 time with an offset, for example 2026-11-20T09:00:00-08:00.

title: List submissions
